page: Google Cloud Platform c4-highmem-48-lssd is an x86_64 server instance optimized for high memory capacity and fast local I/O. The system is driven by a 2.3 GHz Intel Xeon 6985P-C processor configured with 24 physical cores and 48 dedicated vCPUs with hyperthreading. The CPU includes an extensive 504 MB L3 cache, 2 MB L2 cache, and support for hardware extensions such as AVX-512, AMX Tile, and AMX INT8. Memory capacity is provisioned at 372 GB RAM, representing approximately 7.75 GB of RAM per vCPU. Attached to the instance is 3216 GB of local NVMe SSD storage across 8 local SSDs. There are no GPUs provided on this instance type.

Benchmark tests show top-tier performance in single-core Geekbench scoring (2308.0) and high-throughput compression workloads, delivering 36.72 GB/sec in single-threaded gzip compression and 15.53 GB/sec in single-threaded bzip3 decompression. Multi-threaded evaluations also remain strong, including a PassMark CPU score of 70422.1 and Geekbench compiling score of 52966.0. Memory bandwidth reaches 3863.56 GB/sec for cached 16 KB read operations and 178.52 GB/sec uncached. In database operations, the instance registers 88.12 million operations per second in Redis SET operations and strong LLM CPU inference speeds, hitting 341.16 tokens/sec on text generation with small 135M models.

Hardware tradeoffs center around general compute densities and lack of dedicated GPU acceleration. While the large L3 cache and AMX extensions benefit memory-heavy CPU computation and smaller model inferences, larger models encounter standard CPU processing bottlenecks, such as 3.11 tokens/sec on 70B parameter generation. Cost efficiency is favored when workloads can directly capitalize on the bundled 3.2 TB local NVMe array alongside the 372 GB memory pool without incurring separate external block storage overheads.

The c4-highmem-48-lssd instance is well matched for in-memory databases like Redis, high-throughput caching tiers, software build systems, static web serving clusters, and local IOPS-intensive relational database engines.
description: Google Cloud Platform c4-highmem-48-lssd is an x86_64 instance built for memory-heavy and disk I/O-intensive workloads. It is equipped with an Intel Xeon 6985P-C processor running at 2.3 GHz, delivering 48 dedicated vCPUs across 24 physical cores with a 504 MB L3 cache. The server includes 372 GB of system RAM, yielding a generous 7.75 GB per vCPU, and integrates 3216 GB of local NVMe SSD storage across 8 drives without GPU accelerators. Benchmark results demonstrate top-tier single-core Geekbench scores and compression speeds, backed by strong multi-core scaling, software compilation performance, and high Redis throughput of 88.12 million operations per second. Hardware tradeoffs involve lower throughput on large-parameter LLM generation due to the absence of GPUs. The instance is suited for in-memory caching layers, relational databases, data transformation pipelines, and static web serving.
